final: WITH phase_totals AS (SELECT s.phasefactor, SUM(e.imgcount) AS phase_total FROM scanenvironment AS e JOIN sites AS s ON e.zoneref COLLATE BINARY = s.zoneregistry COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY s.phasefactor), overall AS (SELECT SUM(phase_total) AS overall_total FROM phase_totals), phase_shares AS (SELECT p.phase_total, CAST(p.phase_total AS REAL) / o.overall_total AS share FROM phase_totals AS p JOIN overall AS o ON o.overall_total IS NOT NULL), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS mean_share FROM phase_shares) SELECT SUM(p.phase_total), AVG(p.share), AVG(p.share - a.mean_share) FROM phase_shares AS p JOIN average_share AS a ON a.mean_share IS NOT NULL WHERE p.share > a.mean_share
